title: Parashop API
subtitle: Production-Ready Distributed E-Commerce REST API
description: A production-grade, distributed e-commerce REST API built with Django 5.2 and DRF. A modular monolith core (users, products, cart, orders) designed to pair with a planned FastAPI AI recommender microservice — engineered around clean architecture, concurrency safety, and asynchronous processing.
highlights: Custom User Model + JWT auth (SimpleJWT) with custom token claims
Redis-backed shopping cart fully isolated from PostgreSQL until checkout
Concurrency-safe payments & coupons via transaction.atomic + select_for_update
Celery Beat cancels unpaid orders every 5 min and restores inventory
Bilingual (fa/en) catalog with N+1 query optimization (select_related / prefetch_related)
ZarinPal payment gateway, discount coupons, throttling & Swagger (drf-spectacular) docs
snippet:
# Concurrency-safe payment verification
with transaction.atomic():
    order = Order.objects.select_for_update().get(pk=order_id)
    result = ZarinPalService.verify(authority)
    if result.status == 'success':
        order.status = 'paid'
        order.total_paid = result.amount
        order.save()

title: Ecommerce-Ultimate
subtitle: Full-Stack Retail Platform
description: A comprehensive, production-ready full-stack e-commerce solution covering the entire retail lifecycle — from custom role-based authentication and a complex product catalog to cart operations and transactional checkout, with a fully integrated Django Templates frontend.
highlights: Custom auth with Customer / Vendor / Admin role separation
Advanced catalog: categories, brands, variants (color/size), inventory tracking
Transactional cart & checkout with session handling and order integrity
Localized infrastructure: Jalali calendar, National ID & mobile validation
Responsive Django Templates frontend across mobile, tablet & desktop

title: Azad Shop
subtitle: Advanced Distributed E-Commerce API
description: A collaborative, highly scalable e-commerce backend architecture for multi-branch digital retail. Built with a team using Gitflow, emphasizing clean code, advanced ORM query optimization, and secure RESTful API design.
highlights: Collaborative architecture built with Gitflow & agile principles
N+1 query elimination via select_related & prefetch_related
Fully decoupled DRF backend with comprehensive endpoint structures
Robust PostgreSQL modeling for catalogs, inventory & orders
Modular design ready for microservices expansion & containerization
snippet:
# Eliminate N+1 queries across catalog endpoints
class ProductViewSet(ReadOnlyModelViewSet):
    queryset = Product.objects.select_related('category')\
        .prefetch_related('variants', 'images')
    serializer_class = ProductSerializer
    filter_backends = [DjangoFilterBackend, SearchFilter]

title: Wooden Shop
subtitle: Modular Django E-Commerce Architecture Foundation
description: A clean, domain-driven Django 5.2 modular monolith foundation that separates concerns into accounts, orders, and shop business domains — engineered as a scalable base for e-commerce growth.
highlights: Domain-driven app separation: accounts, orders, shop, core
Django 5.2 project with conventional, maintainable structure
Foundation designed for a DRF API layer & PostgreSQL migration
Isolated business domains ready for independent scaling
snippet:
# Domain-driven project layout
wooden_shop/
  accounts/   # auth & user domain
  orders/     # order lifecycle domain
  shop/       # catalog & product domain
  core/       # settings, urls, wsgi/asgi
